summary: W17 is the first v4.4 three-run week (Adj #244): Mon LONG 70 min + 4-6 hill strides / Tue Hyp A / Wed T 6×1K / Thu OFF / Fri VO2 5×1000m @ I / Sat Hyp B lift-only / Sun OFF. Target ~20 mpw, the peak under the new template. Monday carries the whole week — it is W17's entire easy fraction, so a yellow §11.C read trims it in minutes and never moves it; Sun is off by rule and there is no punt slot. Hill strides fire post-long, unperformed since W10 Mon 6-22, treadmill 4-6% substitutable (Adj #236). Two live pace questions land this week: Wed's 6×1K @ T opens at the 7:50 slow end and a firm over-anchor read reopens the band toward 7:50-7:55 (Adj #241); Fri's 5×1000m @ I is the decisive band test — open at the 7:00 fast end, run the prescribed 90 s JOG recoveries after Sunday's walked ones, full ~17.5 min dose, and a sub-anchor read with the confound removed reopens the band ahead of the W19 cut-down (Adj #251/#252). Cadence watch re-armed at I, next read Fri (Adj #253). Lift side: Tue repeats incline 155, 160 only on a ≥RIR 2 five (Adj #237), and the elbow 2nd-movement decision surfaces at the Tue brief (Adj #229); Sat is the first full-dose lift since the deload and fires both held bumps — DB lateral 35→40 (Adj #248) and seated calf 355→365 (Adj #249), whose AM Achilles gate reads Mon 8-17.

days.note: The week's entire easy fraction — 9:15–10:30 conversation-gated, ~6.7–7.6 mi. Strides post-long at 4–6% (Adj #236); a yellow read trims minutes, it does not move (Adj #244).
Incline repeats 155, 160 only on a ≥RIR 2 five (Adj #237). Elbow 2nd-movement decision surfaces at this brief — §10.A gate met 7-31 (Adj #229). Rear-delt back to 2×15 @ 140.
Opens at the 7:50 slow end; RPE ≤7 anchor governs. A firm over-anchor read reopens the band toward 7:50–7:55 ahead of the W19 arbitration (Adj #241). Treadmill at 1% if indoors (Adj #177).
